name: eos-face-capability
description: Use when exposing an existing EOS capability through FACE, deciding which actions belong on a product surface, mapping Work actions to UI affordances, or reviewing whether a frontend action preserves EOS capability, actor, authorization, evidence, and canonical state.
author: EOS Development Team
trigger: Exposing existing EOS capability through FACE surface
Deciding which actions belong on a product surface
Mapping Work actions to UI affordances
Reviewing frontend actions preserve EOS canonical state
Adding new human-facing interface to existing capability

inputs: actor_context: object - User/agent session and permissions
outputs: ui_affordance_spec: object - Defined UI elements for the capability
authorization_verification: object - Server-side policy validation results
readback_test_results: object - Canonical state read-back verification

preconditions: Server-side capability exists in capability registry
Authorization policy is defined and verified

risks: UI affordances breaking canonical capability semantics
Evidence chain broken in surface layer
risk_assessment.impact: High - surface layer violating core EOS authorization principles
risk_assessment.mitigation: Mandatory server-side policy verification before exposure

authority_boundaries: Only maps server capabilities to UI, never creates new capabilities
Can only write mapping files to .eos-state/face/
Cannot modify locked directories: packages/eos-core/foundations/, src/eos/semantics/
